report.title: CreatorIQ demand-generation website audit
report.summary: CreatorIQ presents a clear enterprise creator-marketing proposition with repeated demo CTAs, strong content coverage, visible navigation, HTTPS, analytics, sitemap availability, and responsive layouts. The main conversion risks evidenced in the supplied render are weak form labeling, small controls, missing visible homepage-logo behavior, inconsistent heading structure, low mobile image quality, slow mobile performance, and several Lighthouse accessibility findings. SEO operations and many interaction states remain unverified.

insights.title: `[aria-hidden="true"]` elements contain focusable descendents
insights.description: Focusable descendents within an [aria-hidden="true"] element prevent those interactive elements from being available to users of assistive technologies like screen readers. Learn how aria-hidden affects focusable elements.

insights.title: Buttons do not have an accessible name
insights.description: When a button doesn't have an accessible name, screen readers announce it as "button", making it unusable for users who rely on screen readers. Learn how to make buttons more accessible.

insights.title: Background and foreground colors do not have a sufficient contrast ratio.
insights.description: Low-contrast text is difficult or impossible for many users to read. Learn how to provide sufficient color contrast.

insights.title: Heading elements are not in a sequentially-descending order
insights.description: Properly ordered headings that do not skip levels convey the semantic structure of the page, making it easier to navigate and understand when using assistive technologies. Learn more about heading order.

insights.title: Image elements do not have `[alt]` attributes
insights.description: Informative elements should aim for short, descriptive alternate text. Decorative elements can be ignored with an empty alt attribute. Learn more about the alt attribute.

insights.title: Links do not have a discernible name
insights.description: Link text (and alternate text for images, when used as links) that is discernible, unique, and focusable improves the navigation experience for screen reader users. Learn how to make links accessible.

insights.title: Links rely on color to be distinguishable.
insights.description: Low-contrast text is difficult or impossible for many users to read. Link text that is discernible improves the experience for users with low vision. Learn how to make links distinguishable.

plan.title: CreatorIQ implementation action plan
plan.summary: Prioritise the demo form, mobile controls, and homepage speed to improve qualified conversion and campaign measurement reliability.

sections.heading: Quick wins
sections.body: Fix the conversion path first. These changes address verified form and mobile usability failures.
bullets: Demo fields lack persistent visible labels.
92 mobile controls are below the target size.

sections.heading: Structural improvement
sections.body: Improve homepage loading after the conversion-path fixes. Mobile performance is severely below target.

recommendations.title: Clarify demo form fields
recommendations.rationale: Only 18% of fields have visible labels, and autofill coverage is 58%. Unclear fields can reduce completed, qualified demo requests.
recommendations.action: Add persistent labels, examples, required-state text, and autocomplete attributes to every demo-form field.

recommendations.title: Resize mobile controls
recommendations.rationale: The audit found 92 undersized mobile controls, including six on the demo page. Small targets can cause errors and abandoned requests.
recommendations.action: Set buttons and links to at least 44px high, with adequate spacing between adjacent controls.

recommendations.title: Improve homepage mobile speed
recommendations.rationale: Mobile performance scored 39/100, with 24.9-second LCP and 0.469 layout shift. Slow loading can reduce qualified demo conversion and weaken measurement reliability.
recommendations.action: Compress and properly size homepage images, defer noncritical scripts, and reduce layout shifts on mobile.
